brief: GS's FOMC recap: the Fed hiked 25bp to 3.75-4%, a decision GS calls more hawkish than expected (16-2 majority for another hike, no dissents, neutral dot up to 3.25%, Chairman Warsh repeatedly framing it as removing accommodation). GS revises its call accordingly, now expecting a second 25bp hike in October rather than September being the only 2026 move, while holding its 3.25-3.5% terminal rate by adding a March 2028 cut to prior 2027 cuts. Market Update: equities fell, extending the week's losing streak, on a dot plot showing one more 2026 hike and no 2027 cut; oil dropped 3% despite East-West pipeline headlines, with Iran War resolution still unclear; the AI trade bifurcated, GS's Data Center/AI Semis baskets rising while Software/AI-Productivity baskets fell. Separately: Chevron roadshow takeaways on exploration, government relationships, technology, and capital discipline; Forgent Power Solutions beat on EBITDA, orders and backlog and disclosed first AI-lab and hyperscaler orders, prompting a GS estimate raise; GS's forecasts for tomorrow's Philly Fed index and jobless claims both sit below consensus.
